Subject: Next steps from our discovery call - vendor setup & timelines

Hi Alex,

Thanks again for taking the time today — appreciated the candid discussion about FinServe's latency and compliance needs. Quick recap and proposed next steps so we stay aligned: 

- Summary: You’re evaluating Redwood for low-latency inference on customer-facing flows (target P95 < 300ms) and need SOC2-compliant handling + VPC option for production.
- Demo takeaways: Dedicated pool looks like the best fit to meet throughput and isolation requirements.
- Action items we agreed on:
  1) Procurement: FinServe will need Redwood's vendor setup (W-9 + vendor info) to get the account live.
  2) Timeline: You mentioned finance aims to onboard vendors by end of November — please confirm.
  3) Technical: We’ll provide a short health-check checklist for your infra team.

I’ll loop in our commercial ops team to start the vendor onboarding once you confirm W-9 + remit details. If timelines have shifted, let me know — we can adjust the rollout plan.

Best,
Camila Reyes
